turns.text: The Red Mule Caravan is back in Kettlehold and its wagons are loaded with lamp oil and salt. Fair prices on the upper road for anyone who gets here early.
Die too. there is talk at the foot of the Bell Gate about the bridge and the talk is loud.
Ysaim mind your own business and buy your salt before the the stores close.
Day three Captain Rourke swears he watched the tower all through the dark
at the Ember Well at nine o'clock on the night of day two
